description:
Webhook endpoints that 50heads sends signed events to: list, create, update, rotate the signing secret, test, read deliveries and recent events, replay a delivery, and delete. Question events carry question ids, status, labels, projects and the results summary, so only use an address the person owns and has asked for. Read 50heads://webhook-events for the event types.

Pass action: one of list, create, update, rotate_secret, test, deliveries, events, replay, delete. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- list: The webhook endpoints of this account (personal, or the team the connection acts for): address, events, filter, whether each is on, and how the last delivery went. Secrets are masked. No other arguments. Read-only; needs webhooks:read.
- create: Adds a webhook endpoint: 50heads then sends the chosen events, signed, to that https address as they happen. Question events carry question ids, status, labels, projects and the results summary, so only use an address the person owns and has asked for, and confirm it with them first. The signing secret is in this reply only; give it to the person to store with the receiver. Read 50heads://webhook-events for the event types. Arguments: url (required), events (required), description, filter. Changes something; needs webhooks:write.
- update: Changes a webhook endpoint's address, events, description or filter (filter null clears it), or pauses it (enabled false) and turns it back on (enabled true), also after it was switched off for failing. A new address gets this account's events: confirm it with the person first. Arguments: id (required), url, events, description, enabled, filter. Changes something; needs webhooks:write.
- rotate_secret: Makes a new signing secret for a webhook endpoint and returns it once, in this reply only. The old secret keeps signing beside the new one for overlap_hours (default 24, up to 168), so the receiver can switch without missing a delivery; 0 cuts over at once and deliveries fail until the receiver has the new secret. Arguments: id (required), overlap_hours. Changes something; needs webhooks:write.
- test: Sends a signed webhook.test event to one endpoint now and says how the receiver answered. Use it after action create, a change of address or a secret rotation. Arguments: id (required). Changes something; needs webhooks:write.
- deliveries: The latest 100 webhook deliveries, newest first, with state, the receiver's status, attempts and the last error. Filter by endpoint_id or state; state failed lists the ones that ran out of retries, which action replay sends again. Arguments: endpoint_id, state. Read-only; needs webhooks:read.
- events: The latest events of one type in this account, newest first (limit 1 to 25, default 3), each exactly as a delivery's body carries it: id, type, createdAt, apiVersion and data. Events are kept whether or not an endpoint listens, so use this for a sample payload when writing a receiver, or to catch up on events by id. Arguments: type (required), limit. Read-only; needs webhooks:read.
- replay: Sends a delivery's event again as a new delivery, with the same event id and body, signed with the endpoint's current secrets. Receivers that drop duplicate event ids ignore it if they already have it. Arguments: delivery_id (required). Changes something; needs webhooks:write.
- delete: Deletes a webhook endpoint: no more events go to it, and it cannot be brought back. To stop deliveries for a while, use action update with enabled false instead. Confirm with the person first. Arguments: id (required). Destructive; needs webhooks:write.

action.description: What to do. One of: list, create, update, rotate_secret, test, deliveries, events, replay, delete. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

delivery_id.description: The delivery to send again, such as dlv_…. (Used by: replay.)

description.description: create: A short note to tell endpoints apart. update: null clears it.

enabled.description: false pauses deliveries; true resumes, also after it was switched off for failing. (Used by: update.)

endpoint_id.description: Only this endpoint's deliveries. (Used by: deliveries.)

events.description: create: Event types to send. Read 50heads://webhook-events for what each one carries. update: Replaces the list.

filter.description: create: Question events only for these projects or labels. Events about credits and connections always pass. update: Replaces the filter; null clears it, so every event passes.

labels.description: Only questions with one of these labels.

project_ids.description: Only questions in one of these projects.

id.description: The endpoint id, such as whe_…. (Used by: update, rotate_secret, test, delete.)

limit.description: How many, newest first: 1 to 25. Default 3. (Used by: events.)

overlap_hours.description: Hours the old secret keeps signing beside the new one, 0 to 168. Default 24; 0 cuts over at once. (Used by: rotate_secret.)

state.description: failed: out of retries; replay them once the receiver is fixed. (Used by: deliveries.)

type.description: The event type, such as question.completed. Read 50heads://webhook-events for them all. (Used by: events.)

url.description: create: An https address the person owns, which answers 2xx quickly. update: see the action
